description: Tulvariskialueet is a dataset listed in Paikkatietohakemisto, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by wwwd3.ymparisto.fi. The spatial dataset includes significant flood risk areas for watercourse and sea floods proposed by the ELY Centres and designated by the Ministry of Agriculture and Forestry by 22 December 2024, as well as other flood risk areas identified by the ELY Centres. Coverage: FI. The portal shows the English title as "Flood risk areas" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include FEO, luonnonriskialueet, pintavesi, tulva, INSPIRE-tietotuote. The listing shows 4 download or service links in WMS. The listing shows 2024-11-12 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-paikkatietohakemisto.
